projects.name: Voice Calling Agent
projects.subtitle: Real-time streaming AI voice system
projects.description: A proof-of-concept voice agent: the browser captures microphone audio and opens a WebRTC session with a FastAPI backend, which streams it to an AI provider (OpenAI or Gemini) and plays the voice reply back with live transcripts over WebSocket. A pluggable provider layer sits behind a unified interface, with mid-conversation tool calling (mocked in the repo) and handling of partial transcripts and interruptions. Per-call latency instrumentation logs each stage from WebRTC to AI response to tool call; the repo's tool calls run against a SQLite product catalogue.
projects.stack: Python / FastAPI / WebRTC / WebSockets / OpenAI / Gemini

projects.name: AICompete
projects.subtitle: AI competitive intelligence platform

Background analytics and alerting workflows on Scrapy, Redis and PostgreSQL drive sentiment tracking, keyword detection and automated competitor monitoring.
projects.stack: FastAPI / Celery / Scrapy / Redis / PostgreSQL / Pinecone / LangChain

projects.name: Tailwind Magic
projects.subtitle: CSS-to-Tailwind converter and refactoring utility
projects.description: A command-line utility that converts legacy CSS into Tailwind utility classes across HTML, React, Vue and Angular projects. It uses AST-based parsing and a reverse lookup of Tailwind styles, maps media queries to responsive prefixes, and offers automatic backups, a dry-run mode and detailed conversion reports.
projects.stack: Node.js / JavaScript / AST parsing / Tailwind CSS

projects.name: Handwriting Classifier
projects.subtitle: Human vs. computer-generated text
projects.description: A web app that classifies an image of a word as human-written or computer-generated using a CNN. It trains on handwritten words plus a generated dataset of words rendered in many fonts, with mixed-precision training, logging, and a Flask interface for image upload and prediction.

projects.name: Spell Checker
projects.subtitle: Real-time spelling suggestions
projects.description: A spell-checking web app that flags misspellings as you type, offers live suggestions, and lets you add words to a custom dictionary or clear it. Built with Laravel, Alpine.js and Tailwind CSS.
